about: Batch sizes per plan: batch n holds days (n-1)*size+1 to min(n*size, N). Lanes are day ranges of laneDays per proposing agent; a sensitive day goes to its own lane of two. The order is the plan's (section Order of work): Tao (the pilot is tao-01), Dhammapada, Gita and Upanishads, Analects, the courses, Qur'an, Zhuangzi, Rig Veda, Tanakh, Bible. verifyPerAgent: candidates per verifier, per plan (the Gita’s chapter packets run to 48,000 words).
